title: WAF Traffic overview
description: Panoramica del traffico come la Traffic overview della console AWS WAF.

list.name: site
list.label: Sito
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT site_id FROM waf.agg_requests_1m WHERE minute > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY ORDER BY site_id

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT tuple(count(), countIf(action = 'BLOCK'), uniq(client_ip)) FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS cur, (SELECT tuple(count(), countIf(action = 'BLOCK')) FROM waf.events WHERE ts >= $__fromTime - toIntervalSecond(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime)) AND ts < $__fromTime AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS prev, (SELECT tuple(c, n) FROM (SELECT waf_causa(t.rule_name, e.terminating_type) AS c, count() AS n FROM waf.events e LEFT JOIN (SELECT request_id, rule_id, rule_name, variable, value FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) t ON t.request_id = e.request_id AND t.rule_id = e.terminating_rule_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR e.site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND e.action = 'BLOCK' GROUP BY c ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1)) AS cause, (SELECT tuple(ip, co, org, n, r) FROM (SELECT client_ip AS ip, any(country) AS co, any(as_org) AS org, count() AS n, uniq(terminating_rule) AS r FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND action = 'BLOCK' GROUP BY ip ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1)) AS bip, (SELECT tuple(rn, n, np) FROM (SELECT rule_name AS rn, count() AS n, uniq(path) AS np FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND configured_action = 'COUNT' AND request_action = 'ALLOW' GROUP BY rn ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1)) AS cnt, (SELECT tuple(countIf(status = 200), uniqIf(client_ip, status = 200), countIf(status = 303)) FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND method = 'POST' AND path = '/web/login') AS lg, (SELECT tuple(ip, n) FROM (SELECT client_ip AS ip, count() AS n FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND method = 'POST' AND path = '/web/login' AND status = 200 GROUP BY ip ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1)) AS lgip, (SELECT tuple(m, n) FROM (SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS m, count() AS n FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) GROUP BY m ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1)) AS peak, (SELECT tuple(c, n) FROM (SELECT country AS c, count() AS n FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND country != '' GROUP BY c ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1)) AS ctry, (SELECT tuple(count(), uniq(client_ip)) FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED') AS rl, (SELECT count() FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND action = 'FAIL') AS fails SELECT line AS `In sintesi` FROM (SELECT arrayFilter(x -> x != '', [ concat('📊 ', toString(cur.1), ' richieste da ', toString(cur.3), ' IP; bloccate ', toString(cur.2), ' (', toString(if(cur.1 = 0, 0, round(cur.2 * 100 / cur.1, 1))), '%).', if(prev.1 = 0, ' Nessun dato nel periodo precedente di pari durata.', concat(' Rispetto al periodo precedente: richieste ', if(prev.1 = 0, 'n/d', concat(if(cur.1 >= prev.1, '▲ +', '▼ −'), toString(abs(round((cur.1 - prev.1) * 100 / prev.1))), '%')), ', bloccate ', if(prev.2 = 0, 'n/d', concat(if(cur.2 >= prev.2, '▲ +', '▼ −'), toString(abs(round((cur.2 - prev.2) * 100 / prev.2))), '%')), '.'))), if(cause.2 = 0, '✅ Nessuna richiesta bloccata nel periodo.', concat('⛔ Causa principale dei blocchi: ', cause.1, ' — ', toString(cause.2), ' richieste (', toString(round(cause.2 * 100 / greatest(cur.2, 1))), '% dei blocchi).')), if(bip.4 = 0, '', concat('🎯 IP più bloccato: ', bip.1, if(bip.2 = '', '', concat(' (', bip.2, if(bip.3 = '', '', concat(', ', bip.3)), ')')), ' con ', toString(bip.4), ' richieste bloccate', if(bip.5 > 1, concat(' da ', toString(bip.5), ' regole diverse'), ''), '.')), if(cnt.2 = 0, '', concat('🟡 Regola in count che bloccherebbe di più: ', cnt.1, ' — ', toString(cnt.2), ' richieste su ', toString(cnt.3), ' percorsi. Valuta se passarla in block o aggiungere un\'eccezione (WAF Rules & Tuning).')), if(lg.1 + lg.3 = 0, '', concat('🔑 Login Odoo: ', toString(lg.3), ' riusciti, ', toString(lg.1), ' falliti da ', toString(lg.2), ' IP', if(lgip.2 >= 5, concat(' — ⚠ ', lgip.1, ' ha ', toString(lgip.2), ' tentativi falliti (possibile brute force).'), '.'))), if(rl.1 = 0, '', concat('🚦 Rate limit: ', toString(rl.1), ' richieste respinte da ', toString(rl.2), ' IP.')), if(fails = 0, '', concat('⚠ ', toString(fails), ' richieste con errore interno del WAF (FAIL).')), if(peak.2 = 0, '', concat('📈 Picco: ', toString(peak.2), ' richieste al minuto alle ', formatDateTime(peak.1, '%H:%i', 'Europe/Rome'), ' del ', formatDateTime(peak.1, '%d/%m', 'Europe/Rome'), '.')), if(ctry.2 = 0, '🌍 Paese di provenienza non disponibile (installa GeoIP: README ▸ GeoIP).', concat('🌍 Paese con più traffico: ', ctry.1, ' (', toString(round(ctry.2 * 100 / greatest(cur.1, 1))), '% delle richieste).')) ]) AS lines) ARRAY JOIN lines AS line
SELECT countIf(1) FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))
SELECT countIf(action = 'ALLOW') FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))
SELECT countIf(action = 'BLOCK') FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))

panels.title: In count
panels.description: Consentite, ma una regola in modalità count ha trovato qualcosa (in AWS: CountedRequests).

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(action = 'ALLOW' AND request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT' AND request_action = 'ALLOW')) FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))

panels.title: Rate limit
panels.description: Respinte da una rate-based rule (rate_limit del sito).

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED') FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))

panels.title: FAIL
panels.description: Richieste che il motore WAF non è riuscito a valutare.

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(action = 'FAIL') FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))

panels.title: Richieste: vs periodo prec.
panels.description: Variazione rispetto al periodo precedente di pari durata (es. ultima ora vs ora prima).

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(p = 0, NULL, (c - p) / p) FROM (SELECT countIf(1) AS c FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS a, (SELECT countIf(1) AS p FROM waf.events WHERE ts >= $__fromTime - toIntervalSecond(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime)) AND ts < $__fromTime AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS b

panels.title: Consentite: vs periodo prec.
panels.description: Variazione rispetto al periodo precedente di pari durata (es. ultima ora vs ora prima).

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(p = 0, NULL, (c - p) / p) FROM (SELECT countIf(action = 'ALLOW') AS c FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS a, (SELECT countIf(action = 'ALLOW') AS p FROM waf.events WHERE ts >= $__fromTime - toIntervalSecond(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime)) AND ts < $__fromTime AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS b

panels.title: Bloccate: vs periodo prec.
panels.description: Variazione rispetto al periodo precedente di pari durata (es. ultima ora vs ora prima).

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(p = 0, NULL, (c - p) / p) FROM (SELECT countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS c FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS a, (SELECT countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS p FROM waf.events WHERE ts >= $__fromTime - toIntervalSecond(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime)) AND ts < $__fromTime AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS b

panels.title: In count: vs periodo prec.
panels.description: Variazione rispetto al periodo precedente di pari durata (es. ultima ora vs ora prima).

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(p = 0, NULL, (c - p) / p) FROM (SELECT countIf(action = 'ALLOW' AND request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT' AND request_action = 'ALLOW')) AS c FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS a, (SELECT countIf(action = 'ALLOW' AND request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE ts >= $__fromTime - toIntervalSecond(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime)) AND ts < $__fromTime AND configured_action = 'COUNT' AND request_action = 'ALLOW')) AS p FROM waf.events WHERE ts >= $__fromTime - toIntervalSecond(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime)) AND ts < $__fromTime AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS b

panels.title: Rate limit: vs periodo prec.
panels.description: Variazione rispetto al periodo precedente di pari durata (es. ultima ora vs ora prima).

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(p = 0, NULL, (c - p) / p) FROM (SELECT countIf(terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED') AS c FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS a, (SELECT countIf(terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED') AS p FROM waf.events WHERE ts >= $__fromTime - toIntervalSecond(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime)) AND ts < $__fromTime AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS b

panels.title: FAIL: vs periodo prec.
panels.description: Variazione rispetto al periodo precedente di pari durata (es. ultima ora vs ora prima).

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(p = 0, NULL, (c - p) / p) FROM (SELECT countIf(action = 'FAIL') AS c FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS a, (SELECT countIf(action = 'FAIL') AS p FROM waf.events WHERE ts >= $__fromTime - toIntervalSecond(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime)) AND ts < $__fromTime AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote}))) AS b

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, countIf(action = 'ALLOW' AND NOT (request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT' AND request_action = 'ALLOW'))) AS consentite, countIf(action = 'ALLOW' AND request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT' AND request_action = 'ALLOW')) AS `in count`, countIf(action = 'BLOCK' AND terminating_type != 'RATE_BASED') AS bloccate, countIf(terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED') AS `rate limit`, countIf(action = 'FAIL') AS fail FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(e.ts) AS time, waf_causa(t.rule_name, e.terminating_type) AS causa, count() AS richieste FROM waf.events e LEFT JOIN (SELECT request_id, rule_id, rule_name, variable, value FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) t ON t.request_id = e.request_id AND t.rule_id = e.terminating_rule_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR e.site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND e.action = 'BLOCK' GROUP BY time, causa ORDER BY time

SELECT country AS Paese, count() AS Richieste, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS Bloccate, round(100 * Bloccate / Richieste, 1) AS `% bloccate` FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND country != '' GROUP BY country

SELECT if(country = '', '(sconosciuto)', country) AS `Paese`, count() AS Richieste, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS Bloccate, round(100 * Bloccate / Richieste, 1) AS `% bloccate` FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND 1 GROUP BY `Paese` ORDER BY Richieste DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT if(asn = 0, '(sconosciuto)', concat('AS', toString(asn), ' ', as_org)) AS `ASN`, count() AS Richieste, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS Bloccate, round(100 * Bloccate / Richieste, 1) AS `% bloccate` FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND 1 GROUP BY `ASN` ORDER BY Richieste DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top IP client
panels.description: Clic su un IP: tutte le sue richieste in WAF Richieste.

targets.rawSql: SELECT client_ip AS IP, any(country) AS Paese, any(as_org) AS Rete, count() AS Richieste, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS Bloccate, round(100 * Bloccate / Richieste, 1) AS `% bloccate`, uniqIf(terminating_rule, action = 'BLOCK') AS `Regole`, countIf(terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED') AS `Rate limit`, min(ts) AS Prima, max(ts) AS Ultima FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) GROUP BY client_ip ORDER BY Richieste DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT if(user_agent = '', '(vuoto)', user_agent) AS `User-Agent`, count() AS Richieste, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS Bloccate, round(100 * Bloccate / Richieste, 1) AS `% bloccate` FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND 1 GROUP BY `User-Agent` ORDER BY Richieste DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT path AS `URI`, count() AS Richieste, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS Bloccate, round(100 * Bloccate / Richieste, 1) AS `% bloccate` FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND 1 GROUP BY `URI` ORDER BY Richieste DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT host AS `Host`, count() AS Richieste, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS Bloccate, round(100 * Bloccate / Richieste, 1) AS `% bloccate` FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND 1 GROUP BY `Host` ORDER BY Richieste DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT if(referer = '', '(nessuno)', domain(referer)) AS `Referrer`, count() AS Richieste, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS Bloccate, round(100 * Bloccate / Richieste, 1) AS `% bloccate` FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND 1 GROUP BY `Referrer` ORDER BY Richieste DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT method AS Metodo, count() AS Richieste FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) GROUP BY method ORDER BY Richieste DESC

SELECT if(e.terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED', 'RateLimit', replaceRegexpOne(e.terminating_rule, '^[^/]*/', '')) AS Regola, any(e.terminating_type) AS Tipo, waf_causa(any(t.rule_name), any(e.terminating_type)) AS Causa, countIf(e.action = 'BLOCK') AS Bloccate, uniq(e.client_ip) AS IP, uniq(e.path) AS Percorsi FROM waf.events e LEFT JOIN (SELECT request_id, rule_id, rule_name, variable, value FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) t ON t.request_id = e.request_id AND t.rule_id = e.terminating_rule_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR e.site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND e.action = 'BLOCK' GROUP BY Regola ORDER BY Bloccate DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top label (awswaf:...)
panels.description: Le label aggiunte dalle regole che hanno trovato qualcosa (anche in count): in AWS sono la base per le regole custom e per le metriche per label.

targets.rawSql: SELECT label AS Label, count() AS Richieste, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS Bloccate, countIf(action = 'ALLOW') AS `Consentite (count)` FROM waf.events ARRAY JOIN labels AS label WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) GROUP BY label ORDER BY Richieste DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Login Odoo (stile AWS ATP: account takeover)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND method = 'POST' AND path = '/web/login'
SELECT countIf(status = 303) FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND method = 'POST' AND path = '/web/login'

panels.title: Falliti
panels.description: Odoo risponde 200 (pagina con errore) al login fallito

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(status = 200) FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND method = 'POST' AND path = '/web/login'
SELECT countIf(action = 'BLOCK') FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND method = 'POST' AND path = '/web/login'

SELECT count() FROM (SELECT client_ip FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND method = 'POST' AND path = '/web/login' AND status = 200 GROUP BY client_ip HAVING count() >= 5)

panels.title: Accessi dopo ≥5 fallimenti
panels.description: IP che hanno fatto login con successo dopo almeno 5 tentativi falliti: possibile password indovinata (credential stuffing).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM (SELECT client_ip FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND method = 'POST' AND path = '/web/login' GROUP BY client_ip HAVING countIf(status = 200) >= 5 AND countIf(status = 303) > 0)

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, countIf(status = 303) AS riusciti, countIf(status = 200) AS falliti, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS `bloccati dal WAF` FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND method = 'POST' AND path = '/web/login' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Login per IP
panels.description: Le password non sono mai salvate (redatte nei log); il nome utente sì.

targets.rawSql: SELECT client_ip AS IP, any(country) AS Paese, count() AS Tentativi, countIf(status = 200) AS Falliti, countIf(status = 303) AS Riusciti, groupUniqArray(10)(extractURLParameter(concat('?', request_body), 'login')) AS `Utenti provati`, multiIf(Falliti >= 5 AND Riusciti > 0, '⚠ accesso dopo molti fallimenti', Falliti >= 5, '⚠ possibile brute force', '') AS Nota, min(ts) AS Prima, max(ts) AS Ultima FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND method = 'POST' AND path = '/web/login' GROUP BY client_ip ORDER BY Falliti DESC, Tentativi DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT site_id AS Sito, detail AS `rate_limit` FROM waf.site_rules_current WHERE kind = 'setting' AND rule_name = 'rate_limit' AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) ORDER BY site_id

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, count() AS respinte FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: IP limitati
panels.description: Come GetRateBasedStatementManagedKeys in AWS: gli IP che hanno superato il limite.

targets.rawSql: SELECT client_ip AS IP, any(country) AS Paese, count() AS Respinte, min(ts) AS Prima, max(ts) AS Ultima, if(max(ts) > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE, '🔴 limitato ora', '') AS Stato FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED' GROUP BY client_ip ORDER BY Respinte DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Alert del WAF
panels.description: Regole in Grafana ▸ Alerting (cartella WAF). Per riceverle via email/Telegram/Slack configura un contact point.
